AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Magpie is a personal podcast and article library. Use listShows to find followed shows, then findItems to find items. Item and show IDs belong to the signed-in account: use returned IDs unchanged and repeat a lookup if the account changes. Library searches are read-only and do not enable AI data sharing. Unknown durations are not estimates of listening time. fileListeningItem changes played/read, dismissed, or restored state without AI. undoLastLibraryAction reverses a recent library change; undoListeningSpeed reverses a local speed change. Retry the same filing after a connection failure to recover its original result. Playback actions share the app player. Announce playback only when the returned status says playing. If a play action returns openMagpie, ask the user to open it to finish starting the item; never claim playback has already started.
